items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Melinda used to cook for us and she knew a young man by the name of Ernest Johnson or Ducky Johnson or something like that. Ducky Ernest.

ctx.x: About twenty years ago I remember we were talking about your cook. Didn't your cook have a friend? That was Melinda.

That's when I had to see and know about Cornette. You can go again twenty years ago. That's when I was around twenty. Well you told anybody. Yeah. But Melinda used to cook for us and she knew a young man by the name of Ernest Johnson or Ducky Johnson or something like that. Ducky Ernest. Yeah. Ducky Ernest. And he played with the marching bands. The Buzzards was about three blocks from my house and we'd see them playing maybe Malifaux with the Buzzards, whatever band it was that played for the Buzzards, maybe the…
